Backend: wrote /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_lifecycle.py (17 pytest tests across analytics, lifecycle stage move + gating + 409, attachments upload/list/download/soft-delete + .exe reject, bulk stage/owner/area with blocked reasons, dashboard GET/PUT/reset/default + 403 for viewer, and cross-org isolation). All 17 tests PASSED. Frontend: logged in as platform admin, verified Dashboards renders 6 widgets (roi_rollup, lifecycle_throughput, time_freed, measurement_cadence, inventory_health, roi_by_initiative); shared filters change record count (37→2 when stage=discovery); Arrange mode exposes dash-add-widget/dash-save-btn and Save shows toast 'Your dashboard layout is saved.'; Pipeline shows 8 columns with 25 cards; selecting Approved on opp-nw-2 (no owner) triggers error toast 'Assign an owner before moving to "Approved". Gated stages need an accountable owner.'; Inventory lists 78 records, sortable headers (inv-sort-name), row checkbox reveals inv-bulk-bar with bulk-stage/bulk-area/bulk-owner; Record drawer shows dtab-Files (file-input + file-upload-btn) and dtab-'Lifecycle & Value' with 8 stage-btn-* buttons, lifecycle timeline and benefit inputs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py move_stage/bulk use dict spread but data.stage_history is updated via a replacement list; stage_history is capped only by Mongo doc size — consider pruning or paging if long-lived records accumulate many moves.
Attachments: soft-deleted attachments still occupy object storage. No background purge is implemented — low priority but should be documented.
ALLOWED_EXT is enforced on filename extension only; content-type is not re-validated against bytes. Acceptable for an internal doc store but worth noting.
Dashboard default/personal: there's no versioning or 'who published' metadata on default widgets; auditing is logged but not surfaced in GET response.
